headline: Y. S. Thakar & Co. resigns as cost auditor of Schaeffler India
summary: Schaeffler India announced the resignation of Y. S. Thakar & Co. as its cost auditor, triggering a change in the company's audit leadership. The departure requires the company to appoint a new cost auditor to comply with regulatory mandates. For Indian retail investors, changes in auditors can occasionally signal shifts in governance or routine administrative updates, warranting a check on subsequent filings. The company has not yet named a replacement.
whats_next: Appointment of a new cost auditor
why_it_matters: Routine auditor change, watch for replacement announcement

headline: Schaeffler India announces a change in its statutory auditors.
summary: Schaeffler India Limited has formally notified the stock exchange about a change in its auditors. No further details regarding the identity of the incoming auditor or the reason for the departure were provided in the filing. Such procedural changes are routinely submitted to comply with corporate governance norms. Retail investors can view this as standard corporate housekeeping unless subsequent disclosures indicate disputes.
whats_next: Clarification on the new auditor appointment
why_it_matters: Routine administrative update with no immediate financial impact.
